servicesList.name: Smart Sandwich Panel
servicesList.summary: Lightweight interlocking prefabricated panels with a light EPS-and-cement core wrapped in 4.5 mm calcium silicate boards. Tongue-and-groove edges lock every panel into the next for fast, clean installation.
servicesList.content:
Smart Sandwich Panel is our flagship product — a modern, eco-friendly alternative to traditional brick and concrete hollow blocks. Each panel features a lightweight EPS-and-cement core protected by 4.5 mm calcium silicate boards on both faces. The precision tongue-and-groove design allows panels to interlock quickly and securely, significantly reducing installation time and labour costs.

These panels deliver excellent thermal and sound insulation, fire resistance, impact resistance, and built-in seismic strength. They are much lighter than conventional masonry, reducing structural load and foundation costs. Available in 50 mm, 75 mm, 100 mm and 120 mm thicknesses with lengths up to 3000 mm and standard width of 610 mm, they are ideal for interior and exterior walls, partitions and complete building envelopes in residential, commercial, healthcare, educational and industrial projects.

servicesList.name: Smart Solid Panel
servicesList.summary: Lightweight interlocking panels made from EPS beads, cement, sand, water and bonding agents, reinforced with mesh for extra strength. Both sides are plastered after installation for a smooth finish.
servicesList.content:
Smart Solid Panel is engineered for superior strength and durability while remaining lightweight and easy to handle. Manufactured from high-quality EPS beads, cement, sand, water and special bonding agents, each panel is reinforced with mesh to enhance structural performance and impact resistance.

After installation, both faces are plastered to create a smooth surface ready for final finishing. These panels offer outstanding resistance to impact, fire, moisture and seismic forces. They reduce building weight, speed up construction and lower overall project costs. Available in the same thickness and length options as our Sandwich Panels, Smart Solid Panels are an excellent choice for load-bearing walls, high-rise construction and projects demanding maximum resilience.

servicesList.name: Smart EPS Block
servicesList.summary: Lightweight construction blocks made from EPS beads, OPC cement, water and essential additives. Molded into various sizes for fast, economical and eco-friendly building.
servicesList.content:
Smart EPS Blocks provide a modern, sustainable alternative to traditional clay bricks and concrete blocks. Produced by mixing expanded polystyrene (EPS) beads with OPC cement, water and specialised additives, the material is precisely molded into different sizes and shapes.

These blocks are significantly lighter than conventional masonry, reducing structural load and foundation requirements. They offer good thermal insulation, are easy to cut and handle on site, and help accelerate construction timelines while generating less waste. Available in sizes such as 100×200×600 mm, 150×200×600 mm and 200×200×600 mm, they are ideal for infill walls, partition walls and non-load-bearing applications.

servicesList.name: On-Site Installation Service
servicesList.summary: Professional installation by trained Smart Panel crews using specialised tools for fast, precise and clean on-site assembly.
servicesList.content:
Our trained installation teams ensure every Smart Panel project is completed efficiently and to the highest standard. Using specialised equipment — cutting machines, drill machines, welding machines, thread hand drills and plumb bobs — our crews achieve accurate cuts, secure fixing and perfect alignment.

No heavy machinery or long learning curve is required. Panels are installed quickly with minimal labour, resulting in cleaner sites, shorter project timelines and lower overall costs. We also provide technical guidance and supervision so your project benefits from both premium materials and expert workmanship.

servicesList.name: Technical Consultation & Design Support
servicesList.summary: Expert guidance on panel selection, structural design, seismic performance and project optimisation for architects, engineers and contractors.
servicesList.content:
Choosing the right panel thickness, type and installation method is critical for performance and cost efficiency. Our technical team works closely with architects, engineers and contractors to recommend the most suitable Smart Panel solution for each project.

We provide detailed technical data, seismic performance guidance, thermal and acoustic calculations, and practical advice on foundation design and structural steel savings. Whether you are building a high-rise, hospital, school or residential project, our consultation service helps you maximise safety, speed and value.

blogs.content:
What Is “Smart Panel” in Nepal?

In Nepal’s construction market, Smart Panel refers to a family of prefabricated wall and roof panels manufactured by Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd. – an ISO 9001:2015 certified company with a factory in Bharatpur, Chitwan and a corporate office in Kathmandu.

Smart Panel products mainly include:

  • EPS Sandwich Panels – lightweight panels with an EPS (expanded polystyrene) core sandwiched between cementitious or fiber-cement skins, used for walls and roofs.
  • Smart Solid Panels – denser, cement-based panels for partitions, boundary walls, and applications needing higher impact resistance.
  • EPS Blocks – lightweight blocks used for fill, insulation, and non-structural applications.

These panels are increasingly used for houses, schools, hospitals, offices, resorts, industrial sheds, and rooftop extensions across all 77 districts of Nepal.

Note: “Smart Panel” in this article refers to construction panels, not interactive digital smart boards used in classrooms and offices.

Why Smart Panel Is Becoming the Default Choice in Nepal

1. Earthquake-Resistant Construction

Nepal lies in a high seismic zone. After the 2015 earthquakes and later events like the 2023 Jajarkot quake, engineers and policymakers have prioritized lightweight, ductile structures that perform better in earthquakes.

Smart Panel systems use:

  • Light steel or tubular frames with bolted connections
  • Lightweight EPS/solid panels that reduce seismic mass
  • Proper mechanical anchoring to slabs, beams, and columns

This combination helps buildings absorb and dissipate earthquake energy more safely than heavy, brittle masonry.

2. Much Faster Construction

Traditional brick-and-mortar construction can take 6–12+ months for a standard house. With Smart Panel:

  • Panels are factory-cut to exact sizes in Bharatpur.
  • On-site work is mostly assembly, not wet construction.
  • A 2–3 bedroom home or 3-classroom school block can be completed in weeks instead of months.

Faster construction means:

  • Earlier occupancy or rental income
  • Less monsoon-related delay
  • Lower labor and supervision costs on site

3. Thermal & Acoustic Insulation

The EPS core in Smart Panel sandwich panels acts as an effective thermal insulator:

  • Keeps interiors cooler in summer and warmer in winter.
  • Reduces dependence on electric heaters and coolers, cutting electricity bills.
  • Improves acoustic separation between rooms, corridors, and external noise.

This is especially valuable in:

  • Hill and mountain districts with harsh winters
  • Urban areas with high external noise
  • Schools and hospitals where comfort and quiet matter

4. Cost-Effective Over the Project Lifecycle

While initial per-square-foot costs can be similar to or slightly higher than basic masonry, Smart Panel often proves cheaper overall when you consider:

  • Reduced construction time (earlier revenue/occupancy)
  • Lower foundation loads (smaller footings, less concrete and steel)
  • Less material wastage (factory-cut panels)
  • Lower long-term energy costs due to insulation

For government, NGO, and private projects with tight budgets and timelines, this lifecycle advantage is significant.

5. Clean, Low-Waste, and Eco-Friendly

Smart Panel construction generates:

  • Less on-site dust, noise, and debris
  • Minimal brick and sand consumption
  • Lower overall carbon footprint compared to fired-brick construction

For green building certifications and environmentally conscious clients, this is a strong selling point.

Types of Smart Panel Products

1. EPS Sandwich Panels

Structure: Two strong outer skins (cement/fiber-cement boards) with an EPS + cement core in between.

Typical uses:

  • External walls of houses, schools, hospitals, and offices
  • Roof panels for residential and industrial buildings
  • Cold storage and insulated rooms (with appropriate thickness and detailing)

Key benefits:

  • Lightweight yet strong
  • Excellent thermal insulation
  • Good fire performance (depending on core formulation)
  • Smooth surfaces ready for paint or tiles

2. Smart Solid Panels

Structure: Denser, cement-based panels with or without EPS, designed for higher impact resistance and rigidity.

Typical uses:

  • Internal partitions in homes, offices, and hospitals
  • Boundary walls and compound walls
  • Areas needing higher durability (corridors, stairwells, service zones)

Key benefits:

  • Higher impact and abrasion resistance
  • Suitable for heavy fixtures (cabinets, shelves, handrails) with proper anchors
  • Smooth finish for direct painting or cladding

3. EPS Blocks

Structure: Molded EPS blocks, sometimes cement-coated, used as lightweight fill and insulation.

Typical uses:

  • Roof fill and slope formation
  • Lightweight backfill behind retaining walls
  • Insulation layers in floors and roofs

Key benefits:

  • Very light, easy to handle
  • Reduces dead load on structures
  • Improves thermal performance

Where Smart Panel Is Used in Nepal

Smart Panel systems are now common in:

  • Residential: 1–3 bedroom homes, villas, staff quarters, rooftop extensions
  • Education: Montessori centers, school classroom blocks, labs, libraries, hostels
  • Health: Health posts, PHCCs, hospital wards, isolation units, staff housing
  • Commercial: Offices, showrooms, retail outlets, banks, telecom shelters
  • Industrial: Factory sheds, warehouses, godowns, worker accommodations
  • Tourism: Resort bungalows, eco-lodges, homestays, trekking base camps

Because panels are lightweight and modular, they are especially suitable for:

  • Hilly and remote sites with difficult access
  • Rooftop additions where existing structures cannot take heavy loads
  • Disaster-relief and temporary-to-permanent housing programs

Smart Panel vs Traditional Construction

Aspect Smart Panel (EPS/Solid) Traditional Brick & RCC
Construction Time Weeks for typical buildings Many months to over a year
Earthquake Performance Lightweight, ductile, better behavior Heavy; needs careful detailing to perform well
Thermal Insulation High (EPS core) Low unless extra insulation added
Acoustic Insulation Good to very good (depending on panel) Moderate, varies with wall type
Material Wastage Low (factory-cut) High (on-site cutting and breakage)
Weather Dependency Less affected by rain/season Highly affected by monsoon and winter
Site Mess & Noise Relatively clean and quiet Dusty, noisy, disruptive
Design Flexibility Excellent for modular & repeatable units Very high for complex custom shapes
Lifecycle Cost Often lower (speed + energy savings) Often higher (time + maintenance + energy)

For most standard residential, institutional, and light industrial projects, Smart Panel offers a smarter balance of speed, safety, and cost.

How Smart Panel Is Installed (Brief Overview)

A typical Smart Panel wall installation follows these steps:

  1. Site preparation – clean slab/beam surfaces, mark wall lines and openings.
  2. Adhesive application – cement-based mortar applied to contact surfaces.
  3. Panel positioning – first panel set plumb and aligned; subsequent panels fitted via tongue & groove.
  4. Mechanical anchoring – L-shaped rebar or anchors fix panels to slab, beams, and columns.
  5. Service grooves – shallow chases cut for electrical conduits and plumbing, then filled.
  6. Finishing – skim coat/plaster, primer, paint, tiles, or other finishes as required.

For a detailed installation process, see our Step-by-Step Guide to Installing Smart Solid Panel on Site .

Detailed methods vary by project and must follow Smart Panel’s technical manuals and your structural engineer’s drawings.

Indicative Smart Panel Price & Costing in Nepal

Exact prices depend on:

  • Panel type and thickness
  • Project size and complexity
  • Location and logistics
  • Finish levels and structural system

As a guideline:

  • Prefab houses using EPS/solid panels often fall in the range of NPR 1,800–3,500 per sq. ft. for turnkey construction, depending on specifications.
  • A basic 2BHK prefab home can be delivered within roughly NPR 15–25 lakh, while larger 3BHK homes may range from NPR 26–42 lakh or more, based on design and finishes.

For precise Smart Panel price in Nepal, it’s best to:

  • Share your floor plan and requirements
  • Get a panel schedule and BOQ from Smart Panel
  • Compare total project cost (structure + finishes + time) against conventional options

For more information about prefab homes, designs, and indicative costs, visit our Prefab House in Nepal: Designs & Prices Guide .

Why Choose Smart Panel from Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd.?

Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd. (Smart Panel) is:

  • ISO 9001:2015 certified for quality management.
  • Operating a manufacturing plant in Bharatpur, Chitwan with modern production lines.
  • Supplying to all 77 districts of Nepal, including remote and mountainous areas.
  • Included in government district rate lists, supporting transparent costing and public procurement.

Additional advantages:

  • In-house technical support for design, panel scheduling, and installation guidance.
  • Compatibility with steel frames from local fabricators and international systems.
  • Proven use in schools, health posts, housing projects, and industrial sheds across Nepal.

Common Questions About Smart Panel in Nepal

1. Is Smart Panel safe for earthquakes?

Yes, when used with a properly designed steel frame and correct anchoring. The lightweight panels reduce seismic forces, and the system is aligned with post-disaster reconstruction strategies in Nepal.

2. How long do Smart Panel buildings last?

With proper design, construction, and maintenance, Smart Panel buildings can serve reliably for 30–50+ years, similar to conventional structures. Many projects come with warranties of 10–35 years on key components, depending on the system.

3. Can I use Smart Panel for rooftop extensions?

Step-by-Step Guide to Installing Smart Solid Panel on Site

Smart Solid Panels from Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd. (Smart Panel) are designed for fast, clean, and earthquake-resistant construction of walls and partitions in homes, schools, hospitals, and offices. This guide walks you through a practical, step-by-step installation process that your contractor can follow on site.

Note: Always follow the specific technical manual provided by Smart Panel and your structural engineer’s drawings. The steps below describe a typical method for vertical wall installation using cement-based adhesive and mechanical anchoring.

Before You Start: Tools & Materials

Typical Tools Required

  • Measuring tape, chalk line, and spirit level
  • Electric drill with masonry bits
  • Hammer, rubber mallet
  • Trowel and mixing paddle
  • Saw or panel cutter for trimming
  • L-shaped rebar / anchors as specified
  • Safety gear: gloves, goggles, masks, helmets

Typical Materials

  • Smart Solid Panels (correct thickness for application)
  • Cement-based adhesive / mortar (as recommended)
  • L-shaped rebar or mechanical anchors
  • Jointing compound / filler (if specified)
  • Skim coat, paint, tiles, or other finish materials

Step 1 – Prepare the Work Area

  1. Clear the area of debris, dust, oil, and loose material.
  2. Ensure the floor slab or beam surface is level and structurally sound.
  3. Mark reference lines for columns, openings (doors/windows), and wall runs using a chalk line.

A clean, well-marked base reduces errors and speeds up panel alignment.

Step 2 – Define the Wall Line

  1. Snap a clear line on the floor showing the exact position of the wall.
  2. Transfer this line vertically to columns/beams using a plumb bob or laser level.
  3. Mark positions of door and window openings along the line.

Accurate layout at this stage prevents costly adjustments later.

Step 3 – Clean Panel Surfaces and Structure

  1. Remove dust from the contact surfaces of the slab/beam and columns.
  2. Wipe both sides of each Smart Solid Panel where adhesive will be applied.
  3. Check panels for damage before installation; do not use cracked or broken pieces.

Clean surfaces ensure proper bonding between panel, adhesive, and structure.

Step 4 – Mix and Apply Cement Adhesive

  1. Mix cement-based adhesive mortar as per manufacturer instructions until smooth and lump-free.
  2. Apply a continuous bead or layer of adhesive on:
    • The floor contact line
    • Column/beam contact faces
    • Tongue & groove edges of panels (if specified)
  3. Avoid overly thick layers; aim for uniform coverage.

Proper adhesive application is critical for load transfer and joint strength.

Step 5 – Position and Fix the First Panel

  1. Lift the first Smart Solid Panel and align it with the marked wall line.
  2. Press it gently into the adhesive bed, ensuring full contact at the base and sides.
  3. Use a spirit level to check verticality (plumb) and adjust immediately.
  4. Insert wedges at the bottom to hold the panel in position while the adhesive sets.

The first panel sets the reference for the entire wall, so take extra care here.

Step 6 – Mechanically Anchor the Panel

  1. Drill holes at specified locations near the base and sides (as per engineering details).
  2. Insert L-shaped rebar or mechanical anchors to connect the panel to the slab/beam and columns.
  3. Secure anchors firmly, ensuring the panel remains plumb and aligned.

Mechanical anchoring complements adhesive bonding and improves seismic performance.

Step 7 – Install Subsequent Panels

  1. Apply adhesive to the tongue & groove joints of the next panel.
  2. Fit the panel into place, engaging the tongue & groove with the previous panel.
  3. Check vertical and horizontal alignment continuously.
  4. Repeat anchoring as per design, especially at ends, corners, and around openings.

Maintain consistent joint thickness and alignment for a straight, strong wall.

Step 8 – Cut and Fit Remaining Panels

  1. Measure the remaining gap at the end of each row accurately.
  2. Mark and cut Smart Solid Panels to size using a suitable saw or cutter.
  3. Install cut panels using the same adhesive and anchoring method.
  4. Fill any small gaps with approved jointing mortar.

Precise cutting ensures tight joints and a professional finish.

Step 9 – Create Grooves for Services (Electrical & Plumbing)

  1. Mark locations for electrical conduits, switches, sockets, and water pipes.
  2. Cut shallow grooves into the panel surface using a wall chaser or grinder.
  3. Lay conduits/pipes in the grooves and fix them securely.
  4. Fill grooves with cement mortar or approved filler and allow to cure.

This method keeps services concealed while maintaining panel integrity.

Step 10 – Finish the Wall Surface

  1. Once panels and joints have cured, apply skim coat or plaster as specified.
  2. Sand lightly to achieve a smooth surface.
  3. Apply primer and paint, or install tiles/wallpaper as per design.
  4. Install skirting, architraves, and trims for a clean look.

Smart Solid Panels accept standard finishes, making them compatible with conventional interior design.

Quality & Safety Tips

  • Always work with trained masons and follow Smart Panel’s technical sheets.
  • Use proper PPE (gloves, goggles, masks) when cutting or drilling panels.
  • Do not overload panels during handling; use lifting aids for large sizes.
  • Inspect joints and anchors before applying finishes.
  • Coordinate with electrical and plumbing teams before closing walls.

Why Choose Smart Solid Panel for Your Project?

  • Fast installation: Large panel sizes and tongue & groove joints reduce on-site time.
  • Lightweight yet strong: Reduces structural load while maintaining robustness.
  • Good insulation & acoustics: EPS/cement core improves thermal and sound performance.
  • Seismic-friendly: Light mass and proper anchoring enhance earthquake behavior.
  • Cleaner sites: Less wet work, less waste, and fewer disruptions.

For technical support, panel schedules, and project-specific details, contact Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd. (Smart Panel) at your nearest office in Kathmandu or Bharatpur.

These structures were explicitly designed for steel frames with panelized walls, including options like fiber cement boards, aerated cement boards, or foam-core panels.

UNICEF’s first prefabricated health post in Darbung (Gandaki) was handed over in 2017 as a disaster-resilient facility capable of withstanding:

  • Earthquakes
  • Strong winds
  • Fire and severe weather

Such facilities were expected to last over a decade with proper maintenance, ensuring continuous service even after disasters.

Every month of delay in rebuilding a health post means:

  • Longer travel for patients in remote areas
  • Overcrowded temporary tents or rented spaces
  • Disrupted maternal and child health services

Prefab panel buildings can be completed in weeks rather than months, allowing services to resume quickly.

  • Lightweight panels reduce seismic loads on the structure.
  • Steel frames with panelized walls have performed well in post-earthquake reconstruction programs.

2. Hygienic & Easy to Clean

  • Panels can be finished with washable, antimicrobial-compatible paints suitable for clinics and wards.
  • Reduced cracks and crevices limit dust accumulation and pest harborage compared to poorly maintained masonry.

3. Thermal & Acoustic Comfort

  • Improved insulation reduces reliance on electric heaters in hill and mountain facilities, cutting operating costs.
  • Better acoustic separation between consultation rooms, wards, and staff areas improves privacy and patient comfort.

4. Fast, Clean Construction in Sensitive Areas

Hospital sites often must remain partially operational during construction.

Prefab panels mean:

  • Less noise and dust than conventional brick-and-mortar work
  • Shorter disruption to patient flow and services
  • Faster commissioning of new wards, OPDs, or isolation units

  • Isolation rooms for infectious diseases
  • Staff changing rooms and utility areas

3. Rural & Temporary Hospitals

  • OPD complexes
  • Diagnostic and imaging rooms (with appropriate shielding where needed)
  • Administrative and storage blocks

These can be designed for semi-permanent use (10–20+ years) or as relocatable facilities.

Construction Workflow for Prefab Health Facilities

  • Structural design for seismic loads, wind, and local soil conditions.
  • Infection control considerations: zoning, ventilation, and finish specifications.

  • Lower energy bills due to better insulation

Alignment with National & Donor Programs

This makes Smart Panel a practical choice for:

A prefab (prefabricated) house is a building where major components—walls, floors, and roof panels—are manufactured off-site in a factory and then assembled on your plot like a kit.

blogs.author: Bimal Raj Gosai

blogs.excerpt: Discover why EPS sandwich panels reduce base shear structural forces during earthquakes and why leading structural engineers in Nepal specify Smart Panels for residential and commercial builds.
blogs.content:
Nepal lies in a seismically active zone, making earthquake safety the single most critical factor in structural engineering and architectural design. Traditional brick and concrete masonry structures contribute massive dead load weight to a building, which drastically increases the lateral inertia forces during ground acceleration.

1. Substantial Base Shear Reduction

Seismic inertial force ($F = m \times a$) is directly proportional to the mass of the building. Smart Panels feature a lightweight EPS-and-cement core wrapped in 4.5mm calcium silicate board skins, reducing wall weight by over 60% compared to traditional red brick masonry. Lower mass directly translates into lower base shear force acting on the foundation and beam-column joints.

2. Interlocking Structural Integrity

Smart Sandwich Panels feature tongue-and-groove interlocking side profiles reinforced with cementitious adhesive and steel anchoring. During seismic shocks, the panels act as a continuous shear wall diaphragm rather than individual brittle bricks that crack and collapse outward.

3. High Energy Dissipation & Ductility

The expanded polystyrene (EPS) core possesses elastic compressibility that absorbs and dissipates kinetic vibration energy. Instead of catastrophic brittle failure, the composite matrix absorbs lateral displacement energy, preventing collapse and protecting occupants inside.

4. Reduced Impact Hazard During Shaking

In traditional brick structures, falling brick debris during tremors poses a severe injury risk to occupants and rescuers. Smart Panels are securely anchored to steel or concrete frameworks with L-brackets and steel pins, remaining intact even during violent shaking.

5. Compliance with Nepal National Building Code (NBC)

Smart Panels satisfy the structural design requirements for non-load bearing and shear partition walls under the Nepal National Building Code (NBC 105:2020). Tested for density (124 kg/m³), axial strength, and bending moment resistance, they represent the modern benchmark for seismic resilience across all 77 districts of Nepal.

Smart Panels feature factory-smooth calcium silicate board faces ready for direct putty application and painting. Eliminating two-side cement plastering saves time, material costs (sand, cement, water transport), and eliminates plaster shrinkage cracks.

Nepal experiences extreme climate variation—from scorching 40°C+ summer heat in the Terai plains of Chitwan, Biratnagar, and Nepalgunj to freezing winter temperatures in high altitude zones. Building materials that regulate indoor thermal equilibrium are vital for human comfort and energy preservation.

1. Core Thermal Resistance Physics

Smart Sandwich Panels utilize expanded polystyrene (EPS) beads fused with high-grade cementitious matrix sandwiched between non-asbestos 4.5mm calcium silicate boards. The cellular microstructure of EPS locks trapped air pockets, inhibiting conductive heat transfer.

2. Summer Heat Shielding

In hot regions, traditional brick and concrete walls act as thermal sponges, storing solar heat all day and radiating it indoors throughout the night. Smart Panels reflect solar heat and possess low thermal mass, keeping interior spaces 4-6°C cooler during peak afternoon heat.

3. Winter Heat Retention

In colder months, Smart Panels prevent internal heater warmth from escaping through building envelope walls, keeping rooms cozy and comfortable while reducing electric space heater power consumption.

4. Sound Insulation & Acoustic Privacy

Beyond thermal performance, Smart Panels provide sound reduction of ≥35 dB to ≥45 dB, dampening external traffic noise, rainwater drumming on roofs, and room-to-room audio bleed.
